title: Chapter 1292 - 38: Countless Millennia

Chapter 1292 - 38: Countless Millennia

Chapter 1292: Chapter 38: Countless Millennia

The center of heaven and earth, a secret world.

Silhouettes watched the scene within the images, their thoughts frozen in stupor.

Even the Sect Masters of various Eternal Sects were left mind blank at this sight, unable to react for a long time.

With just one sword strike, all ’demons’ in a vast area were swept away, including a Source Demon.

Such power?

Such power?

Major demons and giant demons were one thing.

But for a Source Demon to be so fragile under that sword?

That was a Source Demon!

A Source Demon with power surpassing that of the Eternal Son.

Even several major Eternal Sects would need to expend a significant amount of foundation to slay a Source Demon.

After the ’demon’ plague, most Source Demons converged in the center of heaven and earth, but a few still slumbered on all sides.

"This is not an illusion."

"Just now, I used an Eternal Treasure to perceive the heavens and the earth, and a terrifying strike erupted in that direction, matching that sword."

At this moment, a Sect Master of an Eternal Sect exhaled deeply and spoke in a grave tone.

The so-called Eternal Treasures are thirteenth-tier weapons left by various Eternal Lords, used as the foundation of the sect.

"Too frightening."

"Comparable to a Source Demon? This is comparable to a Source Demon?"

"How could such a powerful cultivator be born in this world?"

After a moment, the figures suddenly reacted.

Although separated by the image formed through communication runes, their perception of that sword was very vague.

After all, not being present, it is possible to be deceived by illusions and such.

But at the same time.

The Eternal Treasures of various major sects almost simultaneously sensed a strike of extreme and terrifying power appearing at the same time period.

This basically verified that the scene in the image was real.

"The power of this strike is basically equivalent to the strongest strike from our sect’s foundation."

The Sect Master of the Eternal Infinite Sect murmured, looking incredulous.

Wielding the strongest strike with the sect’s foundation can just barely reach this level of power.

But that comes with a price and decreases with each use.

But Lin Yuan?

It is unclear how much power Lin Yuan used to unleash that sword.

But he surely paid no cost.

From the moment he unleashed that sword to the end.

Lin Yuan’s aura remained unchanged, with no weakening at all.

This means the strike is sustainable.

At most, it just consumes more.

How many times better is this compared to the Eternal Sects using their strongest strike from their foundation?

"Such a powerful cultivator?"

Many high-level figures of the Eternal Sects were visibly excited.

Since the great change in heaven and earth, they have been in a kind of despair.

Endless demons, with Demon Gods watching from above.

Even the Eternal Sects see little hope.

They can only prolong their existence.

But in Lin Yuan, they glimpsed hope for the first time.

With such power, not to say invincible below Demon Gods, he can at least easily slay the majority of Source Demons.

...

In contrast to the excitement among the high levels of many Eternal Sects in the secret world at the center of heaven and earth.

The three Eternal Envoys, including the man with silver eyes present at the scene, were trembling in their hearts.

The sword Lin Yuan unleashed did not target them, but merely watching that sword greatly impacted the three Eternal Envoys.

"Too strong."

The man with silver eyes trembled in his heart.

Originally, he thought Lin Yuan’s power might rival a Source Demon.

But now it seems, how much more does it do than just rival?

They just watched as a Source Demon dissolved under that sword.

The other two Eternal Envoys were equally overwhelmed.

The pressure Lin Yuan exerted on the three Envoys almost rivaled the Eternal Treasures in their sects.

"How is it?"

Lin Yuan stood with his hands behind his back, looking at the image formed by the green communication rune.

Not long ago, the Taiyang Divine Spirit explored here and found a Source Demon slumbering in this area.

But relying solely on the two Primordial Spirits and the avatar made it very difficult to perfectly suppress the Source Demon.

Lin Yuan’s avatar could rival a Source Demon, and the strength of the Taiyin and Taiyang Primordial Spirits surpassed that of a Source Demon.

But defeating a Source Demon is easy; suppressing it may involve variables.

Suppression is far more difficult than defeat.

Moreover, Lin Yuan wanted to suppress instantly.

Otherwise, dragging it out could alert other Source Demons and even Demon Gods.

So Lin Yuan’s true body took action this time to solve the Source Demon and nearby demons and giants.

"No problem."

"We will immediately pass all rune inheritances and information regarding ’demons’ to you."

On the other side of the image, the Sect Master of the Eternal Infinite Sect made the decision without hesitation.

The sect masters of the other major Eternal Sects had no objections.

What objection could they have?

With such a strong cultivator on their side, even if Lin Yuan refused to deal with the Source Demons.

The various Eternal Sects would still present all their rune inheritances to Lin Yuan.

All to increase the hope of Lin Yuan becoming an Eternal Lord.

As long as Lin Yuan could become an Eternal Lord, he could cleanse this world of all ’demons.’

The silver-eyed man and the other two Eternal Envoys stood by obediently listening.

At this moment, they also realized Lin Yuan’s significance, potentially ending the ’demon’ calamity ravaging the world.

A few dozen breaths later.

The Eternal Infinite Sect and other Eternal Sects packaged all their Rune Dao inheritances, including those left by Eternal Lords, and transmitted them via the green communication rune to Lin Yuan.

Additionally, the Eternal Sects’ knowledge about ’demons,’ especially intelligence regarding that specific Demon God.

"How should I address you?"

The Sect Master of the Eternal Infinite Sect spoke with a slightly respectful tone.

In this world, strength is revered.

With Lin Yuan’s power, not to mention in the current environment where the ’demon’ is rampant and the Eternal Lord cannot intervene.

Even before the great transformation of the world, he ranked only below the Eternal Lord.

When the Sect Masters of various eternal sects see Lin Yuan, naturally, they must be very respectful.

Strength is everything.

With Lin Yuan’s current combat strength, even the Eternal Son would likely not withstand a single strike.

As for the Eternal Lord? The Eternal Lord would not interfere in matters below the third realm of freedom.

And judging by Lin Yuan’s displayed strength, the hope for him to become the Eternal Lord in the future is certainly much greater than other strong beings, even if the Eternal Lord were to intervene, it would be to form a friendship.

"Call me Galaxy."

Lin Yuan replied casually.

Galaxy was his name within the Chaos Void, and it was used in the first Source World.

Now, he used it again in the second Source World.

"Lord Galaxy, our sects’ runic legacy is all here. If you have any other needs, you can contact us anytime."

The Sect Master of the Eternal Infinite Sect spoke respectfully, "I will have this disciple follow you; he can contact me anytime."

"Hmm."

Lin Yuan glanced at the silver-eyed man.

In fact, he could contact the Sect Master of the Eternal Infinite Sect himself.

But having others convey messages also works.

"Return."

Lin Yuan waved his hand and took the silver-eyed man back to Qingyun Sacred Mountain.

The three Eternal Envoys respectfully exited Qingyun Institute.

At the highest point of Qingyun Sacred Mountain.

"That fluctuation?"

The Sect Master of Qingyun Saint Sect looked solemn; he too sensed the sword Lin Yuan had slashed out, but because the distance was too far, he could only perceive a trace.

Even so, the Sect Master realized its terribleness.

Suddenly.

The sect master’s expression shifted.

"Hmm?"

The Sect Master looked toward the direction of Qingyun Institute, his gaze landing on the three Eternal Envoys.

"Envoys!"

The Sect Master’s expression changed slightly.

As a sect master, he naturally was familiar with the aura of Eternal Envoys.

Swoosh.

The Sect Master immediately appeared beside the three Eternal Envoys.

Although, with Lin Yuan’s protection, he did not regard the Eternal Envoys highly.

But he had to maintain the dignity of the eternal sects and considering Lin Yuan had no hostility toward them.

He naturally stepped forward to greet them.

"Envoys."

The Sect Master approached, immediately greeting them with a hint of respect.

"Don’t call us envoys anymore."

The silver-eyed man’s heart was anxious, he immediately said, "The three of us, under the order of the sect master, are here to heed the instructions of Lord Galaxy."

"Ah?"

The Sect Master blinked.

The so-called Lord Galaxy, he naturally knew referred to Lin Yuan.

But the three Eternal Envoys, to follow Lin Yuan’s instructions?

Still under the mission of the sect master?

The Sect Master’s expression was bewildered.

...

Deep within Qingyun Institute.

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged.

The Sect Master of the Eternal Infinite Sect and several other eternal sect masters meticulously organized and delivered their runic legacies to him.

Although not yet comprehended, Lin Yuan anticipated these legacies would greatly assist him.

However.

Lin Yuan did not immediately comprehend these runic legacies.

Instead, he began to review information on the ’Demon God’.

"Demon God, equivalent to an Eternal Lord without a spiritual will, with actual combat power essentially equal to a true Eternal Lord?"

Lin Yuan’s expression was solemn.

He had long suspected that the Demon God corresponded to the thirteen-level time life form.

But an Eternal Lord without a spiritual will? It should be the physical body of some thirteen-level time life form.

An absence of spiritual will, yet able to rival a true Eternal Lord.

Implying this thirteen-level time life form’s physical body is incredibly strong.

Solely relying on the physical body to rival other time life forms.

One must know, for life forms, spiritual will is extremely important; the execution of various secret techniques requires spiritual will.

Without spiritual will, having only a physical body, despite possessing immense strength, cannot truly be utilized.

If the Demon God truly lacks a spiritual will yet can rival an Eternal Lord, it can be predicted that when their spiritual will was intact, their power was at its zenith.

"Demon God... demon disaster..."

Lin Yuan’s thoughts turned, vaguely sensing the demon disaster is quite complicated.

"No matter, let’s improve strength first."

Lin Yuan focused his mind, thus began comprehending the runic Dao legacies of various eternal sects.

These runic Dao legacies, originating from various Eternal Lords, even included the legacy created by the Lord of Heaven Light.

Not all Eternal Lords established eternal sects; some wandered alone, yet their legacies were recorded by other eternal sects.

While comprehending these runic legacies, Lin Yuan also began to act against the Source Demon.

Firstly, to continuously open up his infinite Constant Sand Particle World, using the Source Demon as the resource for creating the Constant Sand Particle World, is highly efficient, far surpassing great demons and gigantic demons.

Secondly, to fulfill transactions with various eternal sects.

Thus.

Time slowly passed.

A thousand years went by in the blink of an eye.
